text: elaine: Quick design check — noticed a few inconsistent labels during today's console pass :eyes:. The in-product docs flyout shows a header that says "Help Center", the left nav reads "Help", and some deep-link CTAs say "Open in Docs". Feels confusing. sam: Yup I ran into that earlier. Wireframes originally used "Help" but docs team standardized on "Docs" last sprint and we didn't finish the copy sweep. elaine: The worst part is cross-linking. The flyout's "See full article" links to /docs/v1/getting-started but some existing bookmarks point at /help/articles/#api-keys so anchors are getting dropped. Attached a quick snippet:```html See full article ``` raj: Dev note: we have a redirect from /help/* -> /docs/* but it strips anchors (weird nginx rule). I can fix to preserve $request_uri but need a priority. maria: Copy POV: propose we treat "Docs" as canonical for developer-facing content (API, console, SDK guides) and reserve "Help Center" for customer support/how-tos. Suggest CTAs read "Open in Docs" or "View in Docs" consistently. zoe: Accessibility callouts: the flyout needs aria-label on close button (e.g., "Close docs panel"), keyboard focus trap when open, and ensure the "Open in Docs" link includes rel="noopener" and descriptive link text (avoid "click here"). Also check contrast on the flyout header; it's borderline at small sizes. miguel: Agree with the taxonomy. Plan: product + docs editorial align and ship a copy sweep + redirect fix. Does anyone object to changing nav text from "Help" -> "Docs" for dev paths? We can keep a global "Help Center" page for support articles. sam: No objections. I'll open a UI PR to update header/nav copy and add the "Open in Docs" CTA in the flyout. Will include aria-label changes from Zoe. Targeting PR tonight. raj: I'll prioritize the nginx redirect change so anchors survive and add an e2e test for deep links. ETA EOD tomorrow. docs-bot: Created issue RED-432: "Console docs flyout — terminology & cross-linking alignment" and linked it to product board. elaine: Awesome — thanks. For follow-up: can docs editorial draft a one-paragraph canonical statement we can surface in the footer? That would help. @maria can you take that? maria: Yep, will draft and post to the issue by tomorrow morning. Will keep language short: "Developer Docs (Docs)" vs "Help Center (support)" and give guidance for in-product CTAs. sam: Ping me when the copy lands and I'll push the UI changes + request a quick accessibility review. :thumbsup: elaine: Perfect. Marking this thread resolved once PR + redirect are live.
